shared_pair_contract.shared_object: Interacting changes whose actual combined-state verification can reveal incompatible assumptions before more dependent work accumulates.
shared_pair_contract.guard: Changes actually integrate into an identified authoritative mainline with credible verification and repair; branch badges or a CI server do not establish that state.
shared_pair_contract.nontrigger: An isolated artifact or coherent single release can be adequately verified without continuous integration or a clock-driven cadence.
shared_pair_contract.alternative: Use a reproducible combined build and cadence appropriate to actual interaction risk, preserving a cheap adequate final-verification path where there are no ongoing dependencies.
shared_pair_contract.contrary_control: Frequent untested merging can propagate instability faster; late integration cost may arise from accumulated interacting work rather than calendar age itself.
shared_pair_contract.cost: Include merging, verification and repair work, lost isolation and actual dependent rework; count repeated pipeline burden and do not claim a causal productivity effect size.
shared_pair_contract.removal: Removing actual combined-state verification can leave a specific interaction unknown; removing a badge alone does not remove integration.

P038.interpretation: Reject the universal exponential cost law inferred from calendar phase. Distinguish edit/development repair effort, propagation across affected objects, unwinding actual commitments, and failure/recovery loss. Use consequence, coupling, observability, test scarcity, urgency and feasible recovery at the actual change, preserving applicable binding minima. No universal numeric score or threshold replaces the rejected curve.
P038.authority_limit: Economic comparison grants no change, exposure, stop or restart authority. A small code edit can have irreversible effects; available rollback does not undo disclosed information or every transaction. Conversely a useful bounded reduction in one affected population does not require every recovery or assurance condition to hold.
P038.evidence_ceiling: Selected S048 concerns development-phase TSP time/defect logs and repair effort, not all post-delivery harm or economic cost. Its preprint and journal are one study. S047 is an inherited domain account with highly variable multipliers; it does not establish a universal software curve. S008 supplies a risk-driven analytical alternative, not a general causal guarantee. This author freshly read these source metadata, not their primary bodies. Finite invented examples below discriminate meanings; they are not estimates or real guard validations.
